reasons: Both replace the per-peg operators with one bmesh, flag the 0.4 mm single-perimeter wall with correct material-savings math, and explain that join() leaves intersecting shells. B relies on one EXACT boolean union over about 27k faces, which is heavier and less certain, and it slightly overstates how much of a solid peg two perimeters fill.
